verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents its own auto-renewal controls: portfolio-wide via the API and per-domain via the MCP example. Expiry notices exist as signed webhook events covering upcoming expirations. Nothing in the pack documents grace or redemption windows for lapsed domains. Missing for 10: documented grace/redemption periods and lapse-recovery process, explicit per-domain auto-renew toggle in API docs, email/dashboard expiry reminders, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses

citations.quote: Register skaboink.dev if it's under $20, point it at my server, and turn auto-renew on.
Get signed, real-time notifications (registrations, renewals, transfers, upcoming expirations, DNS changes) instead of polling
